name: reserva-de-horarios
description: Monorepo: apps/api (NestJS + Prisma) e apps/web (Vue + Vite)

scripts.start: npm run db:up && (npm run api & npm run web & wait)
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web run test:unit -- --run
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix apps/api run test:e2e && npm --prefix apps/web run test:e2e
